_provenance.source: LAP Manuscript - AM 12.2025.pdf (Mulvey, Lichtenfeld, Nejat, Xiong, Carlson, Mitchell, Mendoza-Halliday, Westerberg, Desimone, Maier, Duque, Bastos -- conserved cell-type architecture / spectrolaminar motif manuscript), read 2026-06-30.
_provenance.cell_type_mapping: E=NG(pyramidal marker), PV=PV, SST~=CB(calbindin), VIP~=CR(calretinin) -- an explicit, user-authorized approximation (CB/SST and CR/VIP are commonly associated but not strictly identical interneuron populations in the literature), not a literal anatomical identity.
_provenance.fraction_basis: Per-layer E/PV/SST/VIP fractions are inherited unchanged from the existing verified jaxfne/configs/canonical-v1-column-1000n.json template (cross-checked against this manuscript's qualitative V1 description -- PV bimodal L3/L4 peak (L4 dominant), CB/CR superficial unimodal peak declining into deep layers, NG primary peak superficial L3 + secondary attenuated deep L5/6 peak -- found qualitatively consistent on inspection of Figure 2A/3A, 2026-06-30). NOT an independent pixel-level digitization of the manuscript's density plots.
_provenance.synapse_tau_basis: AMPA dT_ms=2.0 unchanged from existing template. NMDA dT_ms=100.0 (matches jaxfne.emitters.ReceptorSpec NMDA default) added as a co-released component mirroring every AMPA (E-source) connection, weight=0.6x the AMPA w_mech (standard co-release ratio approximation, not measured). GABA_A dT_ms varied by source cell type using literature-typical IPSC decay time constants: PV(fast-spiking,perisomatic)=6.0ms, SST(dendritic)=25.0ms, VIP(disinhibitory)=12.0ms -- approximate literature-grounded values, not fit to this manuscript's data (which does not report synaptic kinetics).
_provenance.hdp: Not baked into this JSON -- enable via RuntimeConfig(enable_hdp=True, hdp_params=...) at jtfne.simulate() time, per jaxfne's NeuronalTensor+HDP doctrine.
